messages:
mike.h: Heads up — seeing a reproducible canary regression. SDK 1.4.2 + runtime 2.17 + quantized llama3q shows tokenization/KV-cache misaligns in ~2% of requests. stack traces: `kv_cache misalign` and occasional `invalid_cache_index`.

deploy-bot: :warning: Canary alert: canary-llama3q-02 failure rate +3.2% vs baseline. model=llama3q runtime=2.17 sdk=1.4.2. Logs: https://deploy.redwood/canary-logs/canary-llama3q-02

chiara: Can we pin runtime back to 2.16 for the canary pools until we root-cause? Prefer a scoped pin vs global.

sara: +1 for scoped pin. If this is a kernel/quantization regression we shouldn't roll it out further.

kevin: What's the blast radius? only canary, or affected dedicated too?

anita: Confirming: this surfaced in hosted canaries only. No Dedicated reports yet. Keep Dedicated untouched unless we see more signals.

mike.h: I can apply a timeboxed override. Proposed command:

```
/deploy override-pin --target "runtime:2.16" --selector "model=llama3q" --until "2026-03-21T12:00Z" --reason "kv-cache misalign with q-kernels on runtime 2.17"
```

chiara: :thumbsup: please attach INF ticket and add the short description to the release notes. Ticket INF-4123.

mike.h: running the override now. will include a 6h TTL and action ID.

deploy-bot: Override pin created by mike.h — action=pin-4421. Scope: selector(model=llama3q) runtime=2.16. Effective: 1748509999 -> 1748513599 (6h). Notifying router-service and canary pipelines. Owner: mike.h

kevin: Can we add telemetry checks for `kv_cache.align.mismatch` and `latency.p50`? Want short-term watch windows and an on-call notification if either degrades.

chiara: Adding an alert rule: if `kv_cache.align.mismatch > 1%` for 10m, page oncall. Do NOT auto-unpin — auto-unpin is risky here.

sara: Also adding a fallback route: router will send traffic to fallback_model=gptx-mini if canary failure >5% for 5m. Config snippet:

```
route:
  fallback_model: gptx-mini
  threshold_pct: 5
  window_minutes: 5
```

anita: Docs request: update release_notes/runtime_compat.md with note about q-kernel tokenization differences and the temporary pin. I'll file a docs PR.

mike.h: Plan: pin for 6h, triage with infra and runtime team, produce SDK 1.4.3 candidate with kernel patch (ETA ~48h). If SDK candidate ready earlier we'll coordinate controlled rollout.

deploy-bot: Action complete: pin-4421 applied. Canary routing now using runtime=2.16 for selector(model=llama3q). Observability: https://observability.redwood/canary/llama3q. Alerts wired to #oncall.

chiara: Thanks — please add short note to the canary runbook and link INF-4123.

mike.h: Done. Closing pin thread; will reopen if telemetry changes. :white_check_mark:
